content: {"episode_id":"ep-05073","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was medically necessary for this patient, who presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). The study was ordered to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and to correlate the patient's symptoms with rhythm disturbances through extended ambulatory assessment. This service represents a distinct diagnostic evaluation supported by the documented clinical indication and should not be treated as bundled and non-payable under CO-97. We request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 280.18 based on the submitted clinical records."}
